words.def: the specific things (reports, equipment, results) you must hand over in a project.
words.book: I have a few questions about the timeline and deliverables, and I was hoping you could help me out.
uses: Email
Please find the project deliverables below: site survey, single-line diagram and final quotation.
Chat
what are the deliverables for phase 1?
Meeting
Let's agree on the deliverables and dates before we sign.
dont: What are the things we must give in the project?

words.def: to finish something by the time it is due.
words.book: Is there anything I can do to help ensure we hit the deadline?
uses: Email
We're confident we'll hit the deadline for commissioning the UPS system.
Chat
are we gonna hit the deadline on friday? 😬
Meeting
If the batteries arrive late, we won't hit the deadline.

words.def: to finish something, like a meeting, email or project.
words.book: When it comes time to wrap things up, don't forget to include a closing line.
uses: Email
We expect to wrap up the installation by the end of next week.
Chat
let's wrap this up, i have a site visit at 3
Meeting
To wrap up, the next step is to send the revised quotation.

words.def: to end an email or letter with a closing phrase and your name.
words.book: This is where you politely sign off and thank the reader for their time.
uses: Email
Always sign off with "Best regards" when writing to a new customer.
Chat
how do u usually sign off with clients? cheers or regards?
Meeting
A friendly sign-off can make a collection reminder sound less harsh.
dont: How I finish the email in the end?

words.def: to contact someone briefly to see how things are going or get an update.
words.book: I wanted to check in and see if there have been any updates since our last conversation.
uses: Email
I'm just checking in to see if you had a chance to review our quotation.
Chat
checking in: any news from the client on the PO?
Meeting
Let's check in with the site team on Monday.
dont: I am asking about the quotation what happened.
doo: I'm just checking in on the quotation.

words.def: to tell someone formally about something they should notice or deal with.
words.book: I wanted to bring to your attention the problem we've been experiencing with ___.
uses: Email
I'd like to bring to your attention that invoice #2051 is now 60 days overdue.
Chat
just bringing this to your attention: site B UPS is on bypass
Meeting
Thanks for bringing this to our attention — we'll send an engineer today.
goes: thank you for bringing this to our attention
dont: I want to make you notice this problem.
doo: I'd like to bring this issue to your attention.

pro: Subject: Quotation for 20 kVA UPS – Cairo branch
upgrade.why: الـ‎subject line‎ لازم يكون واضح ويقول الموضوع.

upgrade.plain: I send you this email to ask you a question.
upgrade.ar: ببعتلك الإيميل ده عشان أسألك سؤال
pro: I'm reaching out to ask a quick question.
I send you this email for asking.
I write you to ask you one question.
I am waiting you to answer.
I look forward to hearing back from you soon.
upgrade.why: ‎waiting your reply‎ ناقصها ‎for‎ وناشفة؛ ‎look forward to‎ ألطف.

upgrade.plain: Dear Sir, I want the job.
pro: Dear Sir, give me the job please.
Dear Hiring Manager, I'm writing to express my interest in the position.
Hi boss, I want this job.
upgrade.why: لو مش عارف الاسم قول ‎Dear Hiring Manager‎ وادخل في الموضوع بأدب.

upgrade.plain: I write this email to talk about the problem.
upgrade.ar: بكتب الإيميل ده عشان أتكلم في المشكلة
pro: The purpose of this email is to address the issue.
This email is for talking on the problem.
I write to you about problem.
upgrade.why: ‎The purpose of this email is to‎ افتتاحية رسمية واضحة.

upgrade.plain: Ahmed told me to talk to you.
pro: Ahmed said me to talk with you.
I was referred to you by Ahmed.
upgrade.why: ‎referred to you by‎ هي الصيغة المهنية للترشيح.
